summary: Current main reproduces the missing feature by rejecting --kv-cache-dtype int8. The issue does not define an integer quantization/storage contract, and the only related phase-1 Triton-MHA proposal was closed unmerged, intentionally omitted major paths, and no longer applies to the current runtime architecture. No implementation is claimed.

tests.what_was_measured: Current CLI dtype contract; parser rejected int8 before model loading.
Applicability of closed upstream PR #22004 to the recorded base; obsolete/removed paths and changed integration points prevent direct application.
Existing quantized KV-cache compatibility tests: 22 passed, 1 skipped; this does not test INT8.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 was available and a Torch GPU smoke succeeded, but no INT8 KV-cache implementation existed to execute; unrelated GPU activity is not counted as feature evidence.
remaining_limitations: No INT8 KV-cache implementation was accepted or added.
Integer width/signedness, quantization convention, granularity, scale/zero-point metadata, and GGUF mapping are unspecified.
No backend/model/cache-feature support matrix is defined.
No INT8 GPU attention numerical validation or serving-path accuracy validation was possible.

Closed upstream PR #22004 covered only MHA Triton page-size-1 and explicitly excluded MLA, hybrid SWA, double sparsity, PD disaggregation, hierarchical cache, deterministic inference, and Ascend; it does not apply cleanly to current main.
